svg.title: MoE drop vs dropless token buffers
svg.desc: Drop mode uses a static experts by capacity buffer, causing padding for underloaded experts and dropped tokens for overloaded ones. Dropless packs all tokens contiguously with runtime group sizes.
svg.text: Buffer shape [experts, capacity, hidden] is static
16 slots computed: 13 useful, 3 padding, 3 tokens dropped
Buffer shape [tokens, hidden]; group boundaries set at runtime
from the router, changes every step
